cards.title: PK/PD Index Calculation and Unit Consistency
cards.claim: Ratios such as fAUC/MIC or Cmax/MIC require matched strain MIC, compatible units, and explicit definitions. PKNCA examples show that ratios of different units (e.g., ng/mL vs mg/L) must be converted to a common basis before calculation to avoid dimensionless errors.
limitations: Concentration records alone do not supply an integrated exposure endpoint
cards.downstream_use: PK/PD index calculation and target attainment analysis.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
